title: Q-ULTRA-spec_quality-REDESIGN: every second-order step failed to bring Work items an agent cannot misread back in bounds; redesign
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** ladder exhausted for `spec_quality`
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** closed

The same failure three times is a design defect (GUIDING-DIRECTIVE section 2): change the structure, not the parameter.

size: L

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --tick` reads `spec_quality` inside its bounds.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-26T01:42:29Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-26T07:42:15Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-27T06:35:54Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: ultrastability ok: two loops, every variable has a bound and a second-order step
